character.name: Pixel art chibi creature, a golden Scottish Fold cat (folded ears), kawaii and mischievous playful expression, bright sparkling eyes with slightly raised eyebrows, cheeky smile, warm honey-golden fur with vanilla highlights, round fluffy body and short legs. Wearing a small waffle-pattern cape/scarf (cone-waffle texture) draped around the shoulders, slightly fluttering as it moves. On its head: a tiny archer hat made of whipped cream (soft cream shape forming a hunter cap silhouette with a small brim), slightly tilted to the right, with a tiny strawberry pin or berry detail. Overall color grading: subtle purple tint and gentle purple rim-light/glow on edges to match previous forms, plus a soft purple/indigo shadow under the body. Clean readable silhouette, game sprite style, crisp pixels, high contrast, transparent background, no text, no watermark
